arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The city claims the ordinance targets criminal conduct, not speech.
Hicks claims the ordinance chills protected expression by requiring proof of purpose.
The city argues public housing residents need protection from drug markets.
Hicks argues the law restricts basic movement without clear justification.
